title: MiniDAQ acquisition configuration, schema version 1.0
description: Documents the format that minidaq::config::parse_config reads (Chapter 6). The C++ reader is the authority; test_config.cpp checks that this schema and the reader agree on keys, enums and ranges. Comments are allowed in configuration files but not by strict JSON tools.

schema_version.description: MAJOR.MINOR. A reader accepts its own major version and minor versions up to its own.

rt_profile.description: Path of a real-time profile (Chapter 4); empty for none. Read when the configuration is applied.

stop_after_s.description: Stop after this many seconds of data at source.rate_hz; 0 runs until stopped.
